title: Toad in the Hole
description: A classic British dish consisting of sausages cooked in a Yorkshire pudding batter, often served with vegetables and gravy.

ingredients.name: Sausages
ingredients.notes: Choose your preferred type of sausage, such as pork or Cumberland

instructions: Place a 12-cup muffin tin in the oven to heat up.
In a large bowl, whisk together 1 cup of all-purpose flour, 2 eggs, 1 cup of milk, and 1 cup of water. The batter should still be slightly lumpy.
Add salt and black pepper to taste, and mix well.
Remove the muffin tin from the oven and add a small amount of oil to each cup.
Place 1-2 sausages in each cup, depending on their size.
Pour the Yorkshire pudding batter over the sausages, filling each cup about 3/4 of the way full.
Return the muffin tin to the oven and cook for 20-25 minutes, or until the batter is puffed and golden brown.
Serve the toad in the hole hot, garnished with chopped herbs if desired.
